name: memdex
description: Local-first cross-project conversation memory: SessionStart memory index, incremental Stop-hook syncing, and Chinese/English MCP recall over SQLite FTS5.

interface.longDescription: Indexes local Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, and Gemini CLI transcripts into a local SQLite FTS5 store, loads the scoped memory index at session start, imports each finished session on Stop, and exposes recall, note saving, and manual Dream review over MCP. Requires Node.js 22.5+.
defaultPrompt: Search Memdex for what we decided about this project earlier
List my recent conversations across projects
